purpose: Translate public VRS provider and RUE interoperability requirements into clean-room Baudot test candidates without making provider or conformance claims.

authorities.title: 47 CFR 64.621 - Interoperability and portability
authorities.notes: Codified VRS interoperability obligations and incorporation of the 2015 SIP Forum VRS Provider Interoperability Profile TWG-6-1.0.

authorities.title: SIP Forum VRS US Providers Profile TWG-6-2.0
authorities.notes: Ratified April 23, 2020. Kept distinct from the profile version incorporated into the codified rule.

authorities.title: RFC 9248 - Interoperability Profile for Relay User Equipment
authorities.notes: Primary public authority for the RUE-facing registration, call, media, provisioning, dial-around, transfer, and emergency test rows below.

authorities.title: IETF 105 RUM history and 2019 VRS interoperability event material
authorities.notes: Operational evidence of multi-provider SIP, point-to-point, and dial-around interoperability testing; not a conformance source.

authorities.title: MITRE Connects: Improving Telecommunications for the Deaf Community
authorities.notes: Operational evidence that FCC-sponsored interoperability and service-quality testing continues at large call volumes; not a public test specification.

versionBoundary.rule: Do not treat a newer industry profile as incorporated regulatory text unless the codified rule says so.

rows.objective: Register a synthetic RUE with a synthetic provider while preserving configured provider-domain, selected SIP transport, authentication outcome, outbound-flow state, and terminal registration result as separate evidence.
negativeControls: TLS preference missing is visible independently from registration success
doesNotEstablish: TLS security of an external provider

rows.objective: Exercise one-stage dial-around in which a synthetic user on provider A selects provider B for the call and the selected provider domain survives into the actual Request-URI.
negativeControls: default-provider route substituted for selected provider is route-selection failure
dialog success does not imply media readiness

rows.objective: Keep two-stage dial-around distinct from one-stage routing by selecting a synthetic provider front-door URI and supplying the destination only in the subsequent interaction.
negativeControls: one-stage Request-URI semantics cannot be silently substituted for two-stage

rows.objective: Reuse Baudot's re-INVITE and REFER evidence lanes as bounded RUE mid-call tests while retaining media freshness, replacement-dialog identity, accessibility readiness, and old-leg continuity as separate facts.
Qualify implementation-generated RFC 4103 T.140 with one current generation, two redundant generations, and independently measured transmission timing before deriving RTT readiness.
negativeControls: negotiation without text remains not ready
RED payload type without valid redundant generations remains not redundancy-ready
timing is measured rather than inferred from configuration

rows.objective: Exercise the RFC 4103 to RFC 8865 browser-WebRTC gateway boundary without duplicating redundant generations into the semantic stream.
doesNotEstablish: end-to-end encryption across a media-terminating gateway

rows.objective: Negotiate H.264 as the mandatory-to-implement video codec, then advance evidence independently through RTP receipt, decoder input, decoded frames, and rendering.
negativeControls: H.264 SDP agreement without RTP is not media-ready
RTP receipt without decoder evidence is not decoded
decode without presentation evidence is not rendered
existingBaudotReuse: JAIN SIP H.264 SDP/RTP evidence lane

rows.objective: Observe SRTP/SRTCP negotiation and protected media transport as a transport-security fact without promoting it into an end-to-end decryption-authorization claim.
Exercise full ICE and preserve gathering, connectivity checks, selected candidate pair, and subsequent media receipt as separate observations.
negativeControls: dialog establishment without ICE readiness remains not connection-ready
selected pair without media remains transport-only evidence

rows.objective: Retrieve and reduce a deterministic synthetic provider list, allow explicit provider selection, and carry only the selected entry point into a subsequent configuration step.
negativeControls: duplicate or contradictory selection cannot silently choose a provider
doesNotEstablish: existence of a public production provider list

rows.objective: Use synthetic owner/contact information to verify that identity/contact exchange can be carried and correlated without importing real subscriber address-book data.
Validate construction and reduction of synthetic emergency location/additional-data signaling entirely offline or in an expressly authorized isolated test environment.
rows.safetyRule: No public Baudot test originates a real emergency call or probes a production emergency-routing endpoint.

mitreNationalTestLab.use: evidence that repeatable interoperability/service-quality testing is an operational discipline

doesNotEstablish: current behavior of any named VRS provider
access to or behavior of the live TRS Numbering Directory
the contents of MITRE's non-public National Test Lab test suite
authorization to probe production provider infrastructure
